release_notes: SECURITY UPDATE — rebuild the RecipeCove Docker image to patch known vulnerable image-upload and multipart request-processing dependencies.
Upgrade python-multipart 0.0.20 → 0.0.32 to address multipart denial-of-service and parser-differential advisories.
Upgrade Pillow 11.2.1 → 13.0.0 to address image decoder vulnerabilities and the October 21, 2026 Arrow buffer disclosure advisory.
Upgrade FastAPI, Starlette, Uvicorn, Pydantic and cryptography to current compatible secure releases.
Require a passing Python dependency vulnerability audit before future Docker image publication.
IMPORTANT: This update changes Python dependencies. It cannot be installed through Administration → Updates; redeploy the v2.4.1 Docker image through your normal hosting deployment workflow.
Existing RecipeCove volumes, recipe data, users, saved sessions, and Tablet Mode functionality are preserved.
